description:
[Step 2 of explore_information]

Searches Emora's clinician-reviewed resources for parents by words: articles on behavior, conditions, treatment and medication, free self-tests, activities, condition and specialty pages, and clinical insights. Each result has a type, title, description and URL to cite.

Use when: A parent wants to understand something (a behavior, a condition, a treatment, a medication question) or asks for a test, worksheet or activity.

Don't use when: The parent wants a clinician: search_providers or recommend_care.

Example: search_care_resources({ query: 'social anxiety test for teens' })

query.description: The parent's question or topic, in their words.

type.description: Optional. Only this kind of resource.

name: search_care_resources
title: Search care resources
